Identify projects affected by utility delays, grid constraints, equipment lead times, or accelerated energization requirements. Originate and advance opportunities involving mobile gas turbines, bridge power, behind-the-meter generation, distributed generation, microgrids, BESS, and resiliency solutions. Translate customer power requirements into qualified commercial opportunities. Coordinate customer requirements with GenSystems engineering, applications, project management, operations, supply chain, finance, legal, and executive leadership. Lead customer meetings, technical-commercial workshops, proposals, account reviews, commercial negotiations, and contract development. Work with EPC/EPCM firms, design engineers, utilities, developers, IPPs, electrical contractors, and other project partners. Maintain disciplined CRM activity, pipeline forecasting, opportunity qualification, and account reporting. Develop repeat and multi-site business within assigned strategic accounts. Support customer handoff from commercial development into project execution while maintaining senior account ownership. Represent GenSystems at customer meetings, project locations, conferences, and industry events. Required Qualifications Candidates should demonstrate: 8+ years of strategic account management, enterprise sales, business development, data center infrastructure, energy infrastructure, power generation, construction, or related experience. Direct experience working with hyperscale, AI infrastructure, colocation, data center development, utility, EPC/EPCM, power-generation, or mission-critical infrastructure customers . Demonstrated ownership of large, complex customer accounts. Proven ability to originate new commercial opportunities rather than only manage existing accounts. Experience developing relationships across customer technical, commercial, procurement, engineering, construction, operations, and executive stakeholders. Experience managing complex proposals, account plans, negotiations, forecasting, and long-cycle opportunities. Working knowledge of power generation, electrical infrastructure, utility interconnection, distributed energy, behind-the-meter power, or data center power development . Ability to coordinate customer requirements with engineering, EPC, procurement, construction, commissioning, and operational teams. Strong customer presentation, negotiation, relationship-management, and commercial judgment. Ability to work from the Santa Clara market and travel throughout California and the Western U.S. as required. Preferred Qualifications Direct hyperscale account experience with organizations such as Microsoft, Google, Meta, AWS, Oracle, CoreWeave, major colocation providers, or comparable infrastructure customers. Bachelor's degree in engineering, energy, business, construction management, or a related discipline.
